articles.title: WWE Raw results, grades (Oct. 5): Roman Reigns exerts his control; Liv Morgan vs. Becky Lynch ends in double DQ
articles.summary: Roman Reigns returned, while Liv Morgan and Becky Lynch battled for a shot at Stephanie Vaquer's Women's World Title on the "WWE Raw" go-home show as Money in the Bank looms.
articles.body: "WWE Raw" was in St. Louis at the Enterprise Center on this Monday, Oct. 5. The Money in the Bank go-home show was lackluster, to put it bluntly. But it at least gave us some clarity for Saturday's card, with a non-finish in the main event.Finalizing the inevitableEveryone and their dog knew we were getting a Stephanie Vaquer vs. Becky Lynch vs. Liv Morgan triple-threat Women's World Championship match at some point. To get there, we apparently needed a unicorn-esque double DQ in Lynch and Morgan's No. 1 contender match tonight. All three will now collide at Money In the Bank.Plenty of silliness closed out what was expected to be a solid match. The finish ultimately rendered it all moot though, as Vaquer attacked Lynch and Morgan at the same time — after the usual Judgment Day shenanigans.I mean, seriously, this was an egregious usage of interference and referee stupidity. I'm talking Jessika Carr blatantly ignoring Raquel Rodriguez putting Morgan's foot on the ropes. Things of that nature.The Judgment Day get involved but @BeckyLynchWWE SURVIVES 😎 pic.twitter.com/sBuRGeN411— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 To make it all the funnier, Vaquer called out "Raw" general manager Adam Pearce after she ruined the match. He sauntered out from the back, seemingly confused, like he wasn't even watching his own show's main event — one that consisted of the millionth Judgment Day interference he's ignored for what feels like 20 years.Really, everything that happened tonight made Pearce look even worse than he already has throughout this saga. And the "Raw' GM wasn't done either. (More on that later.)A TRIPLE THREAT MATCH AT #MITB!?!? 🙌IT IS OFFICIAL!! @Steph_Vaquer pic.twitter.com/E9z3T4KY4P— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 Monday Night ReturnsIt must be highlighted that any time Roman Reigns isn't on back-to-back episodes of WWE TV, his subsequent appearance is advertised as a "return." That'd be OK if it didn't happen all the time — and if he did more than just talk for less than 20 minutes of a two-and-a-half-hour show. Tonight's "Raw" was a great example of the bait tactic WWE loves these days.The OTC is HERE and so is LA KNIGHT....YEAH!!! 🙌@WWERomanReigns pic.twitter.com/DzBEFVnWKZ— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 That said, Reigns' immediate interaction and promo battle with LA Knight was fantastic. They kept it purely verbal in the ring before their championship match on Saturday. I've completely lost all faith in Knight pulling off the win, so any upset will be even sweeter if he actually does it. (And he should.)But two things are facts: 1) Everything Knight said is true, and, 2) these two men have undeniable chemistry."You're a complainer" 🤯@WWERomanReigns is telling LA Knight OFF! pic.twitter.com/1LE5BmL1XK— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 "You're the most manufactured, corporate puppet, industry plant I've ever seen in my life." 😳@RealLAKnight will NOT back down from the OTC! pic.twitter.com/GS97kf22mO— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 The 946 problemThis angle has become the most "wrestling thing" ever. And if it's all just a roundabout way for WWE to casually sneak Solo Sikoa back into the Bloodline, they will have done that man a massive disservice, given how great he's been by himself or with Knight.SOLO IS BACK 🔥 pic.twitter.com/258Lb4rWKW— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 Reigns oddly wants nothing to do with any of this, and we'll dive into that more later this week in our Uncrowned Horsemen preview for Money in the Bank.But as for Pearce, as previously alluded to, he's allowing 946 to wrestle a match — aka come to work — next week after Jaida Parker literally attempted murder on Jacob Fatu last week.There's no justifying any of this, and WWE isn't trying, which is why it's hilariously just kind of "wrestling being wrestling." But man, is it funny to think about.Ain't NOBODY safe from the 946 😳 pic.twitter.com/1cWc39Awx2— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 👑 Uncrowned Gem of the Night 👑 Speaking of murder attempts, Paul Heyman wants Bronson Reed to end Oba Femi. Permanently. By squishing him. Squishing him with high-impact blows from his body mass at a voluminous rate — otherwise known as a "Tsunami" in wrestling terms.TSUNAMI 🌊@HeymanHustle pic.twitter.com/a9JuEnGTgz— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 This was just great, honestly. And mostly because it was refreshing to see Paul Heyman back doing promo work. The less we see of him, the more appearances like this remind us how great he is. It came after Oba Femi ran through The Vision following their loss tonight to Penta and Je'Von Evans. That's right. The World Tag Team Champions casually lost on a Monday night. I'm not even sure they mentioned the titles during the match.Nonetheless, all this Femi stalling can only last so long, which makes whatever happens this Saturday all the more intriguing. But as of right now, "The Ruler" is treading water and doing nothing of substance."I'm going to PUNISH you" 😲@Obaofwwe is READY for Bronson Reed at #MITB! pic.twitter.com/qKHhNDPxhe— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 OBA FEMI is HERE!! 👏@Obaofwwe pic.twitter.com/vFx7f39bqY— WWE (@WWE) October 6, 2026 I give this "Raw" a crown score of: 5/10 👑WWE Raw full card results and match grades:Women's World Championship No. 1 Contender match: Becky Lynch vs. Liv Morgan ends via double DQ — 👑 3.5/5 👑The Judgment Day (Dominik Mysterio and JD McDonagh) def. Rey Mysterio and Dragon Lee — 👑 3/5 👑Rey Fenix def. Ethan Page — 👑 3.25/5 👑The Judgment Day (Raquel Rodriguez and Roxanne Perez) def. Sol Ruca and Lola Vice — 👑 3/5 👑Penta and Je'Von Evans def. The Vision (Bron Breakker & Austin Theory) — 👑 2.5/5 👑Recap "WWE Raw" with Uncrowned's live blog:

articles.title: CBI raid at Bhagwant Mann’s camp office, FIR against OSD; CM hits back at BJP
articles.summary: CHANDIGARH: The CBI has registered an FIR into corruption allegations involving Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann's Officer on Special Duty (OSD) Rajbir
articles.body: CHANDIGARH: The CBI has registered an FIR into corruption allegations involving Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann's Officer on Special Duty (OSD) Rajbir Ghuman and other senior officials, news agency PTI reported.The FIR follows a Punjab and Haryana high court order directing a probe into alleged irregularities in transfers, postings, government policies and tenders.The high court had directed the CBI to register an FIR after noting that material shared by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) prima facie disclosed cognisable offences.The court had also sought a report on the probe within two months.The CBI has now registered the FIR into the allegations involving Ghuman and other senior officers.Govt to challenge CBI probeThe Punjab government has said it will challenge the high court order directing the CBI probe in the Supreme Court.Chief minister Bhagwant Mann rejected the allegations and accused the BJP of using central agencies against political opponents.Reacting to the development, Mann said in a post on social media:“BJP has started preparations for the Punjab elections. A CBI raid was conducted at my camp office. Now, the ED and CBI will be misused in Punjab to defame the Punjab government and me. The BJP is feeling nervous after seeing the love and support I am receiving from the people.”(With agency inputs)You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Chandigarh | Silver Rate in Chandigarh | Bank Holidays in Chandigarh | Public Holidays in Chandigarh | Chandigarh AQI | Weather in Chandigarh | Petrol Price in Chandigarh | Diesel Price in Chandigarh | CNG Price in Chandigarh | LPG Price in ChandigarhStay updated with the latest Chandigarh news. articles.title: Paramount closes historic Warner Bros. merger to form Skydance | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The deal brings together two major streaming platforms, Paramount+ and HBO Max, along with networks including CBS, CNN, MTV, TBS, Comedy Central, and Food Network.
articles.body:
Paramount announced on Tuesday that it has completed its $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery to create a combined company called Skydance.

The deal, which is one of the biggest mergers of all time, brings together two major streaming platforms, Paramount+ and HBO Max, along with networks including CBS, CNN, MTV, TBS, Comedy Central, and Food Network. Skydance will also gain control of major franchises such as “The Lord of the Rings,” “Game of Thrones,” the DC Universe, and “Yellowstone.”

The merger puts one of the world’s largest entertainment studios under the control of David Ellison. Just last year, Ellison completed his merger of Skydance Media with Paramount, and is rapidly increasing his influence in Hollywood.

The Ellison family is Skydance’s largest shareholder, backed by the billions of Larry Ellison, David Ellison’s father and co-founder of Oracle.

The completion of the deal comes after settlements with a coalition of U.S. states and a Hollywood writers’ union cleared the main legal hurdles facing the merger.

Paramount announced in February that it would acquire Warner Bros. following a bidding battle with Netflix , which had previously reached an agreement to purchase Warner Bros.’ film and television studios and streaming business, excluding its cable networks.

Paramount had sweetened its bid by promising shareholders additional cash if the deal failed to close by a specified deadline and agreeing to cover the breakup fee Warner Bros. would owe Netflix for ending its existing agreement.

“Today is a historic day, not just for Skydance but for our entire industry,” Ellison said in a statement. “From the start, our ambition was to bring these two storied studios together and create a stronger competitor, with the talent, resources, and reach to tell great stories in every genre, on every platform, for audiences everywhere. Our focus now turns to the future: building a company that empowers creatives, entertains audiences and rewards shareholders. We couldn’t be more excited to get to work.”

The new combined Skydance corporation will have annual revenue of nearly $70 billion, the company says.

Skydance Class B shares will begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange today under the ticker symbol “SKYD.”

articles.summary: We have the scoop on the top Prime Day discounts of the October savings event, including tech must-haves, vacuums, fall style upgrades and more.
articles.body: Amazon's October Prime Day is here — and the retail giant is delivering the deals. Amazon It's here! Amazon Big Deal Days, also known as October Prime Day, is in full swing. This savings event runs through the end of the day tomorrow, Oct. 7, so you have some time to plan your shopping strategy — but not unlimited time. Luckily for you, we've done all of the legwork (or "scroll work," as it were) to separate the real deals from the blah of bargains, so you know exactly what's worth adding to your cart … and what's best to save for later. ✔ The best Prime Day deals today Hanes Men's Full-Zip Eco-Smart Hoodie ($10, was $28): Nearly 65% off a bestsellerApple AirPods Pro 3 ($179, was $249): Rare $70 off Shark Pet Cordless Stick Vacuum ($150, was $300): 50% offLevi's Women's Classic Straight Jeans ($22, was $60): Over 60% offNinja Flip Air Fryer and Toaster Oven Combo ($150, was $250): $100 off ✔ New Prime Day deals Medicube Zero Pore Pads ($15, was $19): Rare over 20% off Ugg Whitecap Throw Blanket ($54, was $108): Rare 50% offApple 2026 MacBook Air Laptop ($1,099, was $1,299): $200 off ✔ What to wait on this Prime Day (and how we pick the best deals) Our writers and editors are deal-hunting experts who verify price drops, star ratings and more to help you save money and shop with confidence. Some deals are sneaky: starting prices can be inflated to make discounts look more impressive, and some items are cheaper elsewhere (or we expect a bigger price drop later this year for Black Friday). So we're here to do the hard work for you. Want to know what to skip this Prime Day? Here's what our experts recommend waiting to buy until later this year:• High-end electronics: While we've found some strong tech deals, especially on Amazon devices, mid-range brands and smaller accessories like Apple AirPods, the biggest markdowns on higher-priced tech typically come during Cyber Monday, so it's probably worth waiting a little longer.• Large home appliances: While there are some very worthwhile deals on vacuums and small kitchen appliances, we'll see the deepest discounts on bigger home appliances, like refrigerators and washing machines, come Black Friday.• Toys: Aside from a few smart seasonal buys, like this sale on Lego advent calendars (grab one now, because they're unlikely to be discounted in November when everyone else is shopping for them), we'd skip other toys, as Black Friday is a better time to snag gifts. Our top October Amazon Prime Day deals Best Amazon deals: Style From our style expert: Cozy, mid-weight fall staples have been sitting on retailer shelves since back-to-school season, which means they're most likely to see steep discounts right now. That's because brands need to make room for heavier winter staples like coats and boots. I'd suggest waiting on those heavier layers for now and instead taking a close look at mid-weight jackets (denim, leather, barn coats, shackets, etc.), jeans and sweaters, which will probably all be marked down this week. Browse more style deals here. 5 more standout deals New Balance Men's Sneakers: 50% off Columbia Women's Benton Springs Full Zip Jacket: Just $27 Kate Spade New York Pebbled Leather Handbag: $234 off Tommy Hilfiger Men's 10 Pack Socks: Rare 40% off Calvin Klein Men's 7-Pack Boxer Brief: 30-day low price Best Amazon deals: Home From our home expert: Thinking about getting a new vacuum? Now's a great time to get prepared for holiday visitors and the house cleaning that hosting inevitably requires. I'm seeing discounts of $100 or more from all the big brands, like Shark, Bissell and Dyson — plus major deals on robot vacs. What I'd wait on are towels and sheets. While you can find some great deals on Prime Day, most brands will drop prices even further in January during "white sales." Browse more home deals here. 5 more standout deals Ugg Throw Blanket: Over 40% off Craftsman V20 Cordless Hand Vacuum: Rare discount on an editor favorite Dreamcare Queen Sheet Set: Now only $23 Samsonite Omni 2 Hardside Luggage: Rare 29% off Yankee Candle Sugared Cinnamon Apple: Now only $16 Best Amazon deals: Kitchen From our kitchen expert: If you ask me, fall is the best time to be in the kitchen; it's cool enough to turn the oven on, and we're not yet dealing with holiday-meal-prep stress. Now is a smart time to stock up on smaller kitchen appliances, like air fryers, food processors and immersion blenders for less. (When it comes to larger appliances, like refrigerators and dishwashers, you'll want to wait until Black Friday if you can.) Need some new cookware? You can also find deals on pots, pans and knife sets, but make sure the discounts are really substantial if you're going to purchase now, as practically every big brand will have serious sales come November. Browse more kitchen deals here. 5 more standout deals Vitamix Propel Series 750 Blender: Over 40% off Nespresso Vertuo Pop+ Coffee & Espresso Maker: Now only $99 KitchenAid Ribbed Silicone Oven Mitt, Set of 2: Nearly 70% off Ninja French Door Premier Air Fry Oven: 40% off Our Place Titanium Perfect Pot Pro: Over 40% off Best Amazon deals: Tech From our tech expert: If you've had a piece of Amazon tech on your to-buy list for a while, Prime Day is one of the best times of year to buy it — devices like the Fire TV Stick, Kindle, Echo and Eero tend to see some of their biggest discounts. And with holiday travel right around the corner, I'd look for deals on travel tech and accessories — portable chargers, AirTags, charging cables and noise-cancelling headphones are much cheaper on sale than at the airport when you realize you need them. Laptops and TVs can absolutely be worth buying too, but check the price history — with Black Friday less than two months away, you don't need to jump on a mediocre deal. Browse more tech deals here. 5 more standout deals Apple Watch Smartwatch: Rare 20% off Amazon Fire TV Stick: Now only $18 Amazon Echo Dot: 50% off Anker Nano Smart Charger: Only $24 Samsung 55-Inch The Frame TV: $400 off Best Amazon deals: Beauty From our beauty expert: Prime Day is officially my cue to have my fall beauty routine prepped and ready to go, 'cause once my air conditioner goes into hibernation, I just know my skin is going to be in trouble. On that note, my advice is to grab a good barrier-repair serum and some rich eye cream while it's on sale. Also, keep an eye on Amazon's Premium Beauty shop, where brands that rarely go on sale tend to show up with impressive discounts — some even up to 30%!
